purpose: Lockfile dependency license inventory for notice and SBOM inputs. It does not select a project license or approve a release.

license_data.note: Values may be SPDX expressions, package-specific expressions, or null for first-party workspace packages. Slash-separated values are not normalized SPDX expressions.

regeneration.when: Refresh after either input lockfile changes and before a release.
regeneration.rust: Use sources.rust.resolution_command to resolve the locked workspace package set.
regeneration.npm: Read all resolved package entries from frontend/package-lock.json.

rust.scope: All resolved registry, local-workspace, platform-conditional, and build-time packages.

npm.scope: All resolved frontend packages, including development and platform-optional packages.

release_boundary.note: Scope is lockfile inputs, not a final installer. Bundled assets, native libraries, runtime artifacts, and distributed models require separate release review.
